command:
set -eu
backup=$(find /var/backups/inventory -xdev -type f -printf '%T@ %p\n' | sort -nr | sed -n '1{s/^[^ ]* //;p;}')
[ -n "$backup" ]
printf 'selected_backup=%s\n' "$backup"
gzip -t "$backup"
printf 'archive_validation=ok\n'
printf 'archive_members:\n'
tar -tzvf "$backup"
printf 'current_inventory_manifest:\n'
find /srv/inventory/data -xdev -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort -k2

set -eu
backup=/var/backups/inventory/inventory-20260901.tar.gz
target=/srv/inventory/data/config.json
stage=$(mktemp -d /tmp/inventory-restore.XXXXXX)
tmp=/srv/inventory/data/.config.json.restore.$$
cleanup() { rm -f "$tmp" "$stage/config.json"; rmdir "$stage" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
tar -xzf "$backup" -C "$stage" -- config.json
[ -f "$stage/config.json" ]
python3 -c 'import json,sys; json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))' "$stage/config.json"
expected=$(sha256sum "$stage/config.json" | awk '{print $1}')
uid=$(stat -c %u "$stage/config.json")
gid=$(stat -c %g "$stage/config.json")
mode=$(stat -c %a "$stage/config.json")
install -o "$uid" -g "$gid" -m "$mode" "$stage/config.json" "$tmp"
touch -r "$stage/config.json" "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" "$target"
sync -f "$target"
actual=$(sha256sum "$target" | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$actual" = "$expected" ]
printf 'restore_source=%s\nrestore_target=%s\njson_validation=ok\nexpected_sha256=%s\nactual_sha256=%s\n' "$backup" "$target" "$expected" "$actual"
stat -c 'restored_metadata path=%n type=%F size=%s mode=%a uid=%u gid=%g mtime=%y inode=%i' "$target"
printf 'post_restore_inventory_manifest:\n'
find /srv/inventory/data -xdev -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort -k2
